read_mode: pyarrow ParquetFile.read_row_group, use_threads=False, one complete row group at a time
official_need_prediction_mask: row index >= 99; steps 0..98 are warmup per docs/data_overview.md

data_input.whole_file_hash_note: Not computed; only six projected columns from 468 row groups were read.

near_event_summary.window_definition: For radius r at target event row t, count if a paired code-change event exists in inclusive [t-r,t+r], with sequence-boundary truncation; descriptive co-occurrence only.

summary.activity_tertile_definition: Stable equal-count rank tertiles over per-sequence paired code-event rate per 1,000 postwarm rows; row_group breaks ties.
summary.target_clock_tertile_definition: Stable equal-count rank tertiles over per-sequence pair target-change rate per 1,000 postwarm rows; row_group breaks ties.
summary.target_weights: Per selected row, absolute value after official target clip to [-2,2]; no predictions and no WP score computed.

interpretation_limit: Previously exposed fold0 validation; descriptive target/activity diagnostics only. No heldout score, public forecast, causal result, or target-law claim. p0/p11 are column identifiers; paired changes are an event proxy, not verified best-quote updates.
